description: Time the person spent at a place, which they added to their location history themselves.

main.description: Time the person spent at a place, which they added to their location history themselves. Visits LogDate works out from location samples aren't stored as records; every device works them out again from app.logdate.place.sample records.

place.description: The place (app.logdate.place.place) the person was at.

location.description: Where exactly the person was, when it differs from the place's center.

endsAt.description: When the visit ended. Never before startsAt.

createdAt.description: When the person added the visit, when known.
